title: 3Sum
description: Sort, then for each anchor i, two pointers converge on the remaining pair. Skip duplicates at every level to keep results unique.

notes: Sorting is what unlocks the two-pointer step — without it you cannot decide which pointer to move.
Three layers of dedup: skip equal i, skip equal l after a hit, skip equal r after a hit.
Outer loop stops at length - 2 so l = i + 1 and r still leave room for a pair.

options: So two-pointer convergence can decide which side to move

questions.explain: Sort is O(n log n); the nested two-pointer loop dominates at O(n^2).

options: Skip duplicate triplets at the anchor

blanks.hint: advance left after recording a hit
retract right after recording a hit
sum too small means left needs a bigger value

L3.prompt: Write `threeSum(nums)` returning every unique triplet summing to 0. Log `JSON.stringify(threeSum([-1, 0, 1, 2, -1, -4]))`.
hints: Sort, then fix i and two-pointer the rest.
Skip duplicates on i, l, and r to keep triplets unique.
